cases.sentence: Или взять тех восемнадцать человек, которые погибли, когда на них упала ___.
cases.explain: «Силоамская башня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

cases.sentence: Вы думаете, они были хуже всех ___ Иерусалима?
cases.explain: «других жителей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

cases.sentence: Когда Он это сказал, всем Его противникам стало стыдно, а весь народ радовался ___, которые Он совершал.
cases.explain: «чудесным делам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

cases.sentence: Оно как ___, которое человек взял и посеял в своем саду.
cases.explain: «горчичное зерно» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
